_meanings:
A particle of affirmation or certainty (indeed, truly,
 forsooth), but it is generally used as an expletive; {#Apo vE narasUnavaH#}
 <ls>Ms. 1. 10</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">2. 231</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">9. 49</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">11. 78</ls> <ab>&c.</ab> It is also said to be a vocative
 particle, and sometimes shows entreaty or persuasion ({#anunaya#}).
